en_US: What has our fearless staff witnessed?
The Variety Channel that’s a treasure

At the end of the day, our search
party’s efforts were in vain.
They eventually had to leave the deep
and dark Union Cave.
“If only we had Flash!” the leader cried.
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion to the special program,
“The Cave Plunged into Darkness”!

At the end of the day, our search
party’s efforts were in vain.
We weren’t able to find any UNOWN...
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“Solving the UNOWN Puzzle!”

The search-party leader looked up at
the Johto sky and shouted a promise.
“We won’t fail again!”
It mixed with the sad cries of the
SLOWPOKE that echoed continuously...
Yawn... Yaaawn...
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program, “The
Dark Shadow that Kidnapped SLOWPOKE!”

The forest was dark and gloomy. We could
hear the crunching of fallen leaves under
our feet.
“Leader, this is a dead end!”
“Don’t worry, let’s retrace our steps.”
“Where’s the exit?”
“Come on, we can do it!”
“Let’s just go back already...”
“You’re a guy, aren’t you? Quit whining!”
“Leader, your back...”
“What?!”
“On your back, a Bug-type Pokémon...”
“Eeeeek!”
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“Great Strategy in Ilex Forest!”

The leader of the search party looked
out at the Lake of Rage, quietly
muttering “There’s no such thing as
unstoppable rain.”
He held the Fishing Rod that had been
snapped in two tightly in his hand, and
headed back to headquarters.
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“Look! A Red Gyarados!”

The inside of the cave was covered in
a thick ice, just like a freezer.
“Aaaahchoooo!”
The search party members shivered
in the cold, and huddled around the
fiery PONYTA for warmth.
They were able to beat the cold...
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“The Shivering Path Out of Ice!”

The voyaging search party tried to
think of a solution to the puzzle, but
their thoughts were interrupted and
washed away by the sound of the waves
around the Whirl Islands.
The shadow of a huge Pokémon shifted and
shook in the violent sea filled with
whirlpools...
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program, “The
Legend Disappeared into the Whirlpool!”

The forest was brighter than they
thought it would be.
And they saw so many Trainers there.
“Hey, a Bug Catcher!”
“What?”
“He’s challenged us to a battle!”
“Then accept his challenge!”
“But we don’t have any Pokémon...”
“Simpleton!”
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“The Viridian Forest Search Party!”

We heard that there were Pokémon here,
but we haven’t seen any yet.
We’ve come all the way here to Mt. Moon,
as a search party looking for Pokémon.
We’ve been waiting, spending time here,
and yet the day that we see a Pokémon
hasn’t come yet...
When will we see one? What kind of
Pokémon will come to Mt. Moon?
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“Rumors on Mt. Moon!”

The members of the Pokémon search
party are riding their Bicycles on
Route 17 and singing.
Looking at their faces, they seem to be
relaxing and cycling along as
they please.
But they’re actually doing this to search
for the Pokémon along the route.
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“Illusion Cycling!”

The search party has become lost!
In this strange world, up has become
down, and left has become right!
Then suddenly, right before the confused
search party’s eyes, it appears!
GIRATINA!
There’re so few accounts of anyone ever
meeting this Pokémon. It rarely appears.
But comparing GIRATINA to the few
records that exist, it’s appearance
is different...
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“The Strange GIRATINA!”

The search party has gone on a long
expedition out to the Sinnoh region.
The giant Mt. Coronet, rising up to the
sky from the middle of Sinnoh...
Within Mt. Coronet stretches a complex
system of caverns...
Some members of the search party
struggled through the caverns,
only to ultimately arrive at a
broken bridge.
They thought they’d found ancient ruins.
There was a strange feeling in the air...
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“Found it! The Illusion Space!”

The search party had just about
reached the limits of its physical
strength, when it came to Cerulean
City to rest.
“Look, such a beautiful sunset...”
“Leader! Look over there!”
The member was pointing at a
suspicious-looking cave!
The search party went to explore, and
found a strange flickering shadow...
Tune in next time for the exciting
conclusion in the special program,
“The True Shape of the Cave’s Owner!”
